name: Editorial Evidence
promise: A practice thesis, one signature artifact, and the work that proves it, before anything else.
description: The platform's default composition. It opens with the practice thesis and the signature work on its largest plate, then the flagship works on smaller ones, the proof strip, and the rest of the reading order, with the archive behind a disclosure. Each case study gets its own page. It runs no motion, and its color, type, and materials come from the appearance packs.

sources.source: The v1 Editorial composition's single reading column and section labels
The v1 Editorial palette, fonts, fixed table of contents, and theme toggle
sources.note: Color, type, and display mode belong to the appearance axes (#19), and navigation stays in flow.
